messages.author: 5c0c7ee4f56ce50e
messages.subject: 'Running SWAT' does not finish
parts:
Good day,

When I use RSWAT, I get as far as the point where you then click to Run SWAT. The process begins ('Running SWAT...' box pops up at the bottom right of the screen) but does not run to completion, even if I leave it for many hours. It also does not create the 'CurrentSimulationReport.log' in my Output folder for me to check the running progress. It just continues running indefinitely... Has anyone experienced something similar or know how I could fix this issue? I would be very grateful to receive any guidance.

Thanks and kind regards,
Hannah
